consumables/bitterleaf_poultice.name: Bitterleaf Poultice
consumables/bitterleaf_poultice.description: A sharp-smelling leaf pack used to bind small field wounds.

consumables/hearthloaf.name: Hearthloaf
consumables/hearthloaf.description: A soft brown loaf baked for the same-day market.
consumables/hearthloaf.flavour: Best before the bells finish arguing with one another.

consumables/loam_bread.name: Loam Bread
consumables/loam_bread.description: Dense composting-city fare from Loamgate. Restores a little vigor.
consumables/loam_bread.flavour: Everything returns. Some of it returns as bread.

consumables/loam_smoked_eel.name: Loam-Smoked Eel
consumables/loam_smoked_eel.description: River eel cured over damp loamwood for a long road ration.
consumables/loam_smoked_eel.flavour: Smoke, salt, and a trace of the city beneath the city.

consumables/salted_riverfish.name: Salted Riverfish
consumables/salted_riverfish.description: A small riverfish packed in coarse salt and market paper.
consumables/salted_riverfish.flavour: The Four Arms feed more people than the roads do.

materials/binding_thread.name: Binding Thread
materials/binding_thread.description: Waxed thread for repairs, bindings, and light field stitching.
materials/binding_thread.flavour: Strong enough to hold leather; not promises.

materials/cinder_ink_vial.name: Cinder-Ink Vial
materials/cinder_ink_vial.description: Ash-Bound tattoo ink; names written in it resist the Waning's slow erasure.
materials/cinder_ink_vial.flavour: The soul is a held line. Hold it.

materials/grave_salt.name: Grave Salt
materials/grave_salt.description: Dark mineral salt used to preserve herbs and mark uneasy thresholds.
materials/grave_salt.flavour: It clumps near the recently dead.

materials/iron_rivets.name: Iron Rivets
materials/iron_rivets.description: A counted packet of uniform rivets from Dom's company forges.
materials/iron_rivets.flavour: Every head bears four shallow strikes.

materials/lamp_oil.name: Lamp Oil
materials/lamp_oil.description: A stoppered flask of clean-burning oil for road lanterns.
materials/lamp_oil.flavour: The bottle promises six hours. Wind negotiates.

materials/loamroot_sprig.name: Loamroot Sprig
materials/loamroot_sprig.description: A pale root cutting, still warm from the Loam. Iris wants a few for the grove.
materials/loamroot_sprig.flavour: It roots wherever it lands. That is the trouble with it.

materials/scribes_vellum.name: Scribe's Vellum
materials/scribes_vellum.description: A trimmed vellum folio sized for contracts and field notes.
materials/scribes_vellum.flavour: Margins cost extra. Consequences do not.

relics/captured_reflection.name: Captured Reflection
relics/captured_reflection.description: An obsidian shard that shows a room lit by a sky that does not exist.
relics/captured_reflection.flavour: Do not name what you see in it. Under the Vow, a named Seat must abdicate.

relics/quine_shard.name: QUINE Shard
relics/quine_shard.description: A fragment of pre-Bloom machine, one cyan light still faintly alive.
relics/quine_shard.flavour: It is still counting. No one knows what.

relics/votive_cinder.name: Votive Cinder
relics/votive_cinder.description: A shrine cinder sealed in wax after an offering is witnessed.

tools/field_needle.name: Field Needle
tools/field_needle.description: A heavy repair needle kept in a fitted wooden case.
tools/field_needle.flavour: For canvas, hide, and emergencies no one describes at supper.

tools/lockpick_roll.name: Lockpick Roll
tools/lockpick_roll.description: A compact roll of picks, shims, and a narrow tension bar.

tools/soul_gauge.name: Soul Gauge
tools/soul_gauge.description: A brass-and-glass dial that reads a soul's integrity — and what magic has spent.
tools/soul_gauge.flavour: The needle is honest. That is the problem.

tools/surveyors_chalk.name: Surveyor's Chalk
tools/surveyors_chalk.description: Weather-resistant chalk for route marks and measured circles.
tools/surveyors_chalk.flavour: A line is only useful if someone agrees where it begins.

weapons/forge_hammer.name: Forge Hammer
weapons/forge_hammer.description: A balanced smith's hammer heavy enough for desperate field use.
weapons/forge_hammer.flavour: A tool until the moment it is not.

weapons/roadwarden_spear.name: Roadwarden Spear
weapons/roadwarden_spear.description: A practical ash-shaft spear with an Iron Company pattern head.
weapons/roadwarden_spear.flavour: Long enough to make a roadside disagreement reconsider.

weapons/taubstummer_axe.name: Taubstummer Axe
weapons/taubstummer_axe.description: A sealed soul-weapon of the Last Great War; its edge remembers what it unmade.
weapons/taubstummer_axe.flavour: It does not ring when struck. Nothing it touches does.
